tasks.reason: Sparse coloured seeds extend along several independently inferred rays.
A sparse row or column supplies a period that is repeated across its full axis.
A divider separates a finite prefix from the periodic continuation to be emitted.
Several partial paths or outlines are completed from geometry-specific endpoints.
Nested shapes exchange boundary fragments according to local geometry.
A marker colour fills the enclosed interior of matching partial outlines.
Zeroed damage is restored from a unique reflected counterpart in a dense symmetric grid.
Corrupted cells are repaired from repeated reference regions around the dominant background.
A small seed determines a full alternating rectangular spiral.
A legend colour fills missing cells inside repeated outlined templates.
Sparse symbols are replaced by learned multi-cell stamps.

candidates.operator: Infer the shortest unique one-dimensional period from non-background training prefixes on one axis, then repeat it only into the continuation region.
activation_guards: Every training pair has unchanged dimensions.
Exactly one axis and one shortest period explain every changed cell in every training pair.
The inferred continuation preserves all pre-existing non-background cells.
Applying the operator reproduces every training output exactly.
No rotation, reflection, crop, scale, tile, global colour map, contextual selection/recolour, or component extraction program already explains the task.
reject_when: Two periods or two axes remain train-consistent.
A required output cell is not generated by the repeated one-dimensional motif.
The continuation would overwrite a contradictory non-background cell.
The period or continuation boundary depends on a test output.

candidates.operator: Find a unique repeated or reflected intact reference region and copy only its uniquely determined cells into the corresponding damaged region.
activation_guards: Every training pair has unchanged dimensions.
One reference mapping uniquely identifies every changed cell across all training pairs.
All unchanged target cells are preserved.
Applying the repair reproduces every training output exactly.
The mapping performs structural copy/repair, not colour-conditioned selection, recolouring, or object extraction.
reject_when: More than one reference mapping is train-consistent.
Any changed cell lacks a mapped intact counterpart.
The mapping modifies a cell outside the uniquely identified damage region.
The reference or damage mask depends on a test output.

promotion_gate.decision: A candidate advances only if it independently passes both screen and confirm. Passing this gate does not update the registry or champion.

next_stage_policy.rejected: Revert all solver behaviour changes and retain only the analysis and rejection reason in docs.
next_stage_policy.accepted: Verify stdin-exec compatibility, then run Kaggle proof before any registry or champion promotion.
